recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a large red header with a thick slab-serif nameplate and a photographic lower section depicting a man with a guitar and a dog on a white-painted wooden porch.
coreVisualRelationships: Red header block occupies the top 25% of the frame
Subject and dog are seated in matching white wicker rocking chairs
Horizontal porch lines contrast with the verticality of the house siding
Black corner accents in the red header frame the primary text
coreInvariants: Muted, naturalistic lighting in the photograph
High-contrast red and black graphic elements at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man with guitar positioned right of center; dog positioned left of center; both mid-ground scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white text on the red background acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, down to the dog, across the porch floor to the man's face and guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space provided by the house siding and the porch floorboards.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red used for the primary header background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White used for the main typography and porch furniture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black used for the header borders and side panel.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic header versus desaturated, earthy tones in the photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, white, and natural wood/denim tones.

letterConstructionRules: Square, heavy serifs with no brackets
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface paired with small, secondary sans-serif metadata.
graphicDevices: Inverted corner notches on the red header box
Black vertical sidebar for technical metadata

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric slab serif structure.
Provides the necessary weight and blocky serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a baseball cap playing an acoustic guitar while sitting in a white wicker rocking chair on a wooden porch. Next to him, in a second matching chair, sits a small white dog with black ears. The house behind them has white horizontal siding and a window. The lighting is soft daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid red rectangular banner across the top 25% of the image. Add a thin black border inside the red banner with notched corners. In the center of the red banner, typeset the name in a white, extra-bold slab-serif font. Add a black vertical strip on the far right containing small white technical icons.

verificationChecks: Text is centered in the red block
Slab serifs are thick and blocky
Dog and man are in separate chairs

adjustableVariables: Subject activity (e.g., reading instead of playing guitar)

mustAchieve: Clean separation between graphic header and photographic base

postGenerationChecks: Is the red header exactly at the top?
Are the slab serifs heavy and white?
Is the dog visible in its own chair?
Does the black sidebar exist on the right?
recipe.reuseFormula: Graphic Header (Red + Slab Serif) + Rustic Lifestyle Photography (Porch/Country Theme) = Classic Country Album Aesthetic
